title: Three kinds of death
source_text:
Kətwa … kətwa təǧǧā́r, kətwa təǧǧā́r. 
U+təǧǧarano kul+naqla mbalwa arbʕi+baġle. 
Gamle, gamle hawxa, gamle, ḥaṣayye ha háwxayo, gámlene.
Kǝmballe me Diyā́rbakər, kǝmballe lǝ Gziro, kəmballe lǝGziro. 
Komaṭʕan aṭ+ṭaʕnayḏe me Diyā́rbakər, kəzzé lǝ Gziro … ann+arbʕi+ṭaʕnayḏe … hul dkomoṭe lǝ Gziro. 
Kobe laf+faqire, kobe lu+ʕulmo. 
U+ḥa dkoloqele, kobele parčaye. 
Kobe kul+naqla, kobe gāh təšʕo+ṭaʕne, gāh tmanyo, gāh təšʕo, gāh ʕaṣro kobe. 
U+zlamano masule. 
Masule, azzé bann+əšne. 
Qām u+abro ḥəḷḷe ebe, hawxa ḥəḷḷe lu+abro ebe. 
Omar, ‘Yabo!’ 
Omar, ‘Ha?’ 
Omar, ‘Yabo, aǧ+ǧenik̇atayḏux ḥawiri. 
Yabo, ʕaršux hánostene šlīḥ ḥa mənne. 
Yabo, kobaʕno dyətwat, ono ksōmno məḥlofux i+taǧǧaraṯe. 
Ono ksōmna məḥlofux’. 
Omar, ‘Lawo, ma gdəḏʕat saymat xoṯi?’ 
Omar, ‘E, yabo, e’. 
Omar, ‘Dəḏʕat, gdobenux. 
Lo – lo, 
lə+gbenux, lawo. 
Ono d̥kəzzino lǝ Gziro, kobeno kul+naqla təšʕo+ʕaṣro+ṭaʕne lan+noše faqire, xēr diḏi, kobenanne laf+faqire’. 
Omar, ‘Tǝmā́m, yabo, ahla ŭ sahla’. 
Qām hánostene, u+təǧǧarànostene, maslamle u+qliḏo lu+abro. 
Lu+abro mədle lu+qliḏo ŭ qrele la+greʕayḏe, maṭʕanne arbʕi+ṭaʕne, maṭəʕnənne. 
U+zʕurano maṭi lǝ Gziro, hule traḥṣar+ṭaʕne, hule traḥṣar. 
Fāšle tmanyo ŭ ʕəsri+ṭaʕne.
Omar, ‘Ḥetu aṭ+ṭaʕnaṯxu harke. 
Gəzzino ḥōrno, gəzzino ḥōrno bi … kalá baxča basəmto, be haṯe mǝn báxčayo? 
Kal kazzí li+baxčaṯe, ḥozina, mək kīt eba, bi+baxčaṯe’. 
U+zʕurànoste koʕobar, komaḥti a+greʕe aṭ+ṭaʕne, ŭ hiye kəzzé li+baxča. 
Koḥōr, kalá biro dmaye, kalá biro dmaye. 
I+biràyostene, koḥōr bam+maye ḥewore, basime.
Omar, ‘Haymén kšoteno maye mi+biraṯe’. 
Híyestene, u+rabban, koṭowe qarʕe hawxa, dšote, – e, 
i+lappe ʕul me qarʕe komaḥwo. 
Komaḥwo lappe ʕul me qarʕe, iḏo ʕul me qarʕe, dmaḥtile, dmaḥti qarʕe bi+birayo. 
Koḥōr hawxa ḥeḏǝr ruḥe, koḥōr, noše lə+kḥoze. 
Pāk hano məʕ ʕaǧóboyo! 
Naqqa+ḥreto ṭwele qarʕe. 
Ṭwele naqqa+ḥreto disa, disa mḥele i+lappe dmoḥela. 
Maʕlele qarʕe, koḥōr, noše lə+kḥoze. 
Omar, ‘Ala lə+kšoteno’. 
Nafəq qǝm feme du+tarʕo, koḥōr: kalé sofi bfeme du+tarʕo. 
Hiye bḥəšbone du+kurko ǧǝnnániyo, ‘Ǧǝnnániyo’, u+kurrəkano, ‘ǧənnániyo’. 
Komar, ‘Qay lə+štelux maye?’ 
Omar, ‘Haymén lə+šteli maye, ŭ ṭweli qarʕi tarte+kore, ṭweli qarʕi dšoteno, da+tlaṯ lo+maǧreli. 
Lo+maǧreli dsōmnanne tlaṯ+kore. 
Nafəqno’. 
Omar, ‘Ono u+mšadro d Alóhono, malóxono. 
Ono u+mšadro d Alóhono, malóxono’. 
‘Ánnaqqa kšuqlat ruḥi?’ 
Omar, ‘Lo’. 
Omar, ‘Lǝ+kšoqalno ruḥux’. 
Omar, ‘Zux, štay, amár əšme dǝṣlibo ŭ štay. 
Dray u+ṣlibayḏux ʕal foṯux ŭ štay’.
ŭ drele u+ṣlibayḏe ʕal foṯe ŭ štele. 
Štele. 
Omar, ‘Maṭʕenu aṭ+ṭaʕnaṯxu’. 
Maṭʕanne aṭ+ṭaʕnaṯṯe, blile lǝ Gziro. 
(Lu+sofiyawo kə́twayle daqno hawxa, hno sófiyo.) 
Azzehən lǝ Gziro, naḥiti, azzehən gab u+xānči. 
Məḷḷe lu+xānči, omar, ‘Xānči!’ 
Omar, ‘Ha?’ 
Omar, ‘U+zʕurano u+abro dəflānkasyo. 
Lu+babo mšāʕle u+zʕurano. 
Kobaʕno, ʕayni xǝd u+babo, dhowatle moro, dhowatle moro lu+malayḏe ŭ i+dukṯo, u+babayḏe dǝmḥalafwa u+māl. 
Be ayko mḥalafwayle kobaʕno dmaḥwatle ad+dukkananək, ŭ dəzzeyo lad+dukkananək mḥalaf u+malayḏe. 
Omar, ‘Tǝmā́m’.
Qām məḷḷele, omar, ‘Ono kal kazzino. 
Šamiʕat?’ 
Komaḷḷe lu+zʕuro, komar, ‘Ono kal kazzino. 
I+numro ḥṣar, i+numro ḥṣar. 
Itúx lu+baytawo. 
Li+numro dkətyo ḥṣar.’  
Omar, ‘Tǝmā́m’.
Hawyo i+saʕa ḥṣar, azzé li+numro da+ḥṣar, koḥōr, kalá ḥurma ŭ zlām. 
U+zlām, i+daḥṯo kǝmḥalqo b̥foṯe, kodoʕaṯ. 
U+kurk̇o koʕobar, ‘Šlomo’. 
Komar, ‘Ahla ŭ sahla!’ 
Komar li+ḥurma, komar, ‘Qǝm hawle fako dlaḥmo ŭ mofeqe. 
Ṭro nofaq’. 
Kəmmo, ‘Kwīš bayto dbabux. 
Kalúx miṯo! 
Áydarbo gdoballe fako dmuklo, gməfqalle? 
Hăma ḏayfo ḏayfo d Alóhoyo, ṭro yotaw larġul’. 
Omar, ‘Lǝkwe’ – omar, ‘D̥fōš harke, gmōṯno’. 
Hawxa omar, e. 
Qām u+zʕurano, nafəq. 
Mofaqla li+žənk̇e, mabramla hawxa … oda … maḥatla tamo bi+odayo, ǝmmo, ‘De dmax harke, dmax harke. 
Məs saymono?’ 
Daməx tamo. 
Aṯi u+malaxo, omar, ‘Qǝm!’ 
Məḷḷe lu+kurk̇o omar, ‘Qǝm!’ 
Qām aṯi, fatili, aṯən su+zlamawo u+naxwaš, dkətwa kayiwo. 
Omar, ‘Ḥur, mə ksōmno bi+ruḥayḏe!’ 
Mḥele bam+maḏrabat, šqile i+ruḥayḏe, šqile i+ruḥayḏe. 
Mḥalaqqe li+bemresaye, li+pisitiye, mḥalaqla b̥feme ŭ bǝnḥire mi+bemresayayḏe. 
Omar, ‘Lawo, u+ḏayfo – u+ḏayfo d Alóhowa. 
Hawxa səmlux bu+zʕurano’. 
Axər šqile i+ruḥayḏe, nafiqi tre+ǧewǝrk̇at dak+kalbe bǝnḥire. 
Tre+ǧewǝrk̇at d̥kalbe nafiqi bǝnḥire, kome bemrés. 
Omar, ‘Tǝmā́m’. 
Omar, ‘Ramḥəl i+numro ḥḏaḥṣar i+saʕa ba+ḥḏaḥṣar tux ltamo’. 
Omar, ‘Tǝmā́m’. 
Azzé i+numro ḥḏaḥṣar, hawi dēr du+lalyo, i+saʕa hawyo ḥḏaḥṣar, azzé li+numro ḥḏaḥṣar, koḥōr, kalayo žənk̇e kal komkafro i+daḥṯo du+merk̇o. 
ŭ komarle lu+merk̇o, komar, ‘Šlomo’. 
Komar, ‘Ahla ŭ sahla! 
Ḥurma!’ 
‘Ha?’ 
— Omar, ‘Qǝm hawle fako dmuklo. 
Hawle fako dmuklo ŭ hawle nvine, ṭro domax bi+odayhenik̇é’. 
Əmmo, ‘Merk̇o, kalé … harke i+oda, kalá xliṯo, ṭro domax tamhenik̇é’. 
Omar, ‘Lo, hawle nvine ŭ ṭro domax bi+odayo, ŭ tǝmā́m’. 
Əmmo, ‘Ḥayra, tǝmā́m!’ 
Mbela, azzé u+kurk̇o. 
Mbela li+žənk̇e, əmmo, ‘De dmax harke, lawo!’ 
Daməx tamo. 
Daməx tamo, hawyo i+saʕa ḥḏaḥṣar. 
Aṯi, aṯi u+maloxo. 
Aṯi u+maloxo, omar, ‘Qǝm’. 
Mərle lu+merk̇o, omar, ‘Tux, ḥur!’ 
Aṯi. 
Hulele dabbūz, nṣəfle me ḥḏoḏe, lu+maloxo mtaḥte raġle šqile i+ruḥayḏe. 
Nafiqo ḥḏo k̇avok̇e, ḥḏo, ḥḏo. 
Nafǝq ǧewǝrk̇o d̥kalbo. 
(Háṯeste i+maʕnáyoste, gdomáṇṇanxuyo. 
Gdomaṇṇux háyostene.) 
Qām omar, ‘De tux, i+saʕa ba+traḥṣar, itúx li+numro traḥṣar, tux ltamo!’ 
Omar, ‘Tǝmā́m’.  
(Heš əzzí bəṯra? 
Omaṇṇo?  
E, e. 
Mdawám, amár!)
Qām hánostene … kuyo i+numro traḥṣar … koṯe. 
Komar, ‘Qǝm!’ 
Aṯi, yatu gabe, yatu gabe. 
I+naqqa dyatu gabe, omar, ‘Ḥur áydarbo kšoqaṇṇo i+ruḥo du+zlamano’. 
Omar, ‘Ahla ahla ahla bu+mšadro d Aloho, ahla. 
Tux tux tux tux’. 
— komaḷḷe lu+maloxo.
Hánoste, u+maloxo, koyotaw qǝm raġle du+zlamawo, u+kùrk̇oste kalé tamo yatiwo. 
Košṓf raġle, košṓf raġle, kogoraš i+ruḥayḏe lbarke. 
Maṭyo lbarke, košṓf barke, u+maloxawo košōf barke, hul dmaṭyo lṣadre, larke diḏe. 
Maṭyo hul ṣadre. 
Maṭyo lṣadre, omar, ‘Ḥur áydarbo košoqanno i+ruḥayḏe, košoqanno’ …’Ahla …’ … Maṭyo i+ruḥo larke. 
Disa komar, ‘Ahla, ahla bu+mšadro d Aloho’.
Qām hedik̇a, maṭyo llarke diḏe, šqile i+ruḥayḏe. 
Nafiqi tarte+k̇avok̇at ḥewore əmmi pərrr... Azzə́n, yatiwi se Mšiḥo. 
Maġalle lat+tarte+k̇avok̇atanǝk se Mšiḥo, s Aloho. 
Azzə́n s Aloho at+tarte+k̇avok̇atanǝk. 
Omar gdomannanxu, ḥuru komar, ‘U+issā́n, dhowe ṭawwo, dhowe mʕadlo, dhowe … ŭ d̥ḥowe aḏ+ḏayfe, dobe xēr ŭ xeratat, – hawo, i+ruḥayḏe hawxa gməšqolo, basəmto gməšqolo.
U+ issā́n, dhowe qasī́s, dhowe pīs, dlo+ḥowe aḏ+ḏayfe, – hawo, háwoste, kowele čike idara.
Hăma u+ḥreno, dḏayfe dlo+ḥowe, dlobe xēr ŭ xeratat, dhowe ganowo, dhowe ṭalǝb ḥărā́m, dhowe ṭalǝb ḥărā́m, dhowe pīs, dhowe pīs bi+briṯaṯe, dhowe hawxa pīs, hawo malkuṯo lukwe d̥ḥoze. 
Gmiḥalaq li+koraye di+gihano. 
Koraye di+gihano gmiḥalaq. 
ŭ hun sāġ!

items.value: Hăma u+ḥreno, dḏayfe dlo+ḥowe, dlobe xēr ŭ xeratat, dhowe ganowo, dhowe ṭalǝb ḥărā́m, dhowe ṭalǝb ḥărā́m, dhowe pīs, dhowe pīs bi+briṯaṯe, dhowe hawxa pīs, hawo malkuṯo lukwe d̥ḥoze.

But the other one, who does not host guests, who does not give charity and alms, who is a thief, who is a crime seeker, who is a crime seeker, who is wicked, who is bad in this world, who is wicked like so, it is not for that one to see the Kingdom.

sentences.translation: He will be cast into the depths of Gehenna.

items.value: He will be cast into the depths of Gehenna.

sentences.translation: Into the depths of Gehenna will he be cast.
